accepted.name: posts_questions_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS question_id,
  title,
  body,
  SAFE_CAST(accepted_answer_id AS INT64) AS accepted_answer_id,
  SAFE_CAST(answer_count AS INT64) AS answer_count,
  comment_count,
  community_owned_date,
  creation_date,
  SAFE_CAST(favorite_count AS INT64) AS favorite_count,
  last_activity_date,
  last_edit_date,
  last_editor_display_name,
  last_editor_user_id,
  owner_display_name,
  owner_user_id,
  SAFE_CAST(parent_id AS INT64) AS parent_id,
  post_type_id,
  score,
  tags,
  SAFE_CAST(view_count AS INT64) AS view_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
accepted.description: Normalized projection of question posts with cleaned numeric casts and canonical column names. Use this as the canonical questions relation for downstream joins, aggregates and time-series. Preserves identifiers needed to join to answers, users, votes, comments and tags. | Use for: time-series of question volume or scores; top questions by views/score/answers; join to answers, comments, votes, users by question_id or owner_user_id; filter by tags or date ranges

accepted.name: posts_answers_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS answer_id,
  title,
  body,
  accepted_answer_id,
  SAFE_CAST(answer_count AS INT64) AS answer_count,
  comment_count,
  community_owned_date,
  creation_date,
  SAFE_CAST(favorite_count AS INT64) AS favorite_count,
  last_activity_date,
  last_edit_date,
  last_editor_display_name,
  last_editor_user_id,
  owner_display_name,
  owner_user_id,
  parent_id AS question_id,
  post_type_id,
  score,
  tags,
  SAFE_CAST(view_count AS INT64) AS view_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
accepted.description: Normalized projection of answer posts with cleaned numeric casts and canonical column names. Use this as the canonical answers relation for downstream joins to questions, users, votes and comments. | Use for: aggregating answer counts or scores per question or user; finding answers for a given question or accepted answers; join to users, comments, votes using answer_id or owner_user_id

accepted.name: users_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS user_id,
  display_name,
  about_me,
  CAST(age AS INT64) AS age,
  creation_date,
  last_access_date,
  location,
  reputation,
  up_votes,
  down_votes,
  views AS profile_views,
  profile_image_url,
  website_url
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
accepted.description: Clean projection of users with key profile and activity measures. Useful for joining to posts, comments, badges and aggregations by user. | Use for: user reputation or activity summaries; join to posts/answers/comments by owner_user_id/user_id; filter users by location, reputation, or creation_date

accepted.name: posts_questions_answer_stats
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  q.question_id,
  q.creation_date AS question_creation_date,
  COUNT(a.answer_id) AS answers_total,
  AVG(NULLIF(a.score, 0) + 0) AS avg_answer_score,
  SUM(a.comment_count) AS answers_comment_count,
  q.comment_count AS question_comment_count
FROM posts_questions_core AS q
LEFT JOIN posts_answers_core AS a
  ON a.question_id = q.question_id
GROUP BY q.question_id, q.creation_date, q.comment_count
accepted.description: Aggregated stats per question: counts of answers, comments across answers, average answer score and total comments on question. Useful for ranking or filtering questions by answer quality/engagement. | Use for: identify questions with many answers or high-quality answers; time-based analysis of answer activity per question; combine with question metadata to surface under-answered questions

accepted.name: questions_topk_score_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  question_id,
  title,
  score,
  view_count,
  answer_count,
  creation_date,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS score_dense_rank,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC, view_count DESC, creation_date ASC) AS score_row_number
FROM posts_questions_core
accepted.description: Window-ranked questions by score with a dense rank so downstream queries can implement Top-K by filtering rank <= K. Exposes creation_date for time-windowed top-k queries. | Use for: return Top-K questions by score (downstream WHERE score_row_number <= K); time-windowed top questions by joining on creation_date; combine rank with tags to get top questions per tag

accepted.name: posts_with_user_info
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.id AS post_id,
  p.post_type_id,
  p.title,
  p.body,
  SAFE_CAST(p.accepted_answer_id AS INT64) AS accepted_answer_id,
  SAFE_CAST(p.answer_count AS INT64) AS answer_count,
  p.comment_count,
  p.creation_date,
  p.last_activity_date,
  p.score,
  p.tags,
  SAFE_CAST(p.view_count AS INT64) AS view_count,
  p.owner_user_id,
  u.display_name AS owner_display_name,
  u.reputation AS owner_reputation,
  u.location AS owner_location
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` AS p
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` AS u
  ON p.owner_user_id = u.id
UNION ALL
SELECT
  p2.id AS post_id,
  p2.post_type_id,
  p2.title,
  p2.body,
  p2.accepted_answer_id,
  p2.answer_count,
  p2.comment_count,
  p2.creation_date,
  p2.last_activity_date,
  p2.score,
  p2.tags,
  p2.view_count,
  p2.owner_user_id,
  u2.display_name AS owner_display_name,
  u2.reputation AS owner_reputation,
  u2.location AS owner_location
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` AS p2
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` AS u2
  ON p2.owner_user_id = u2.id
accepted.description: Denormalized posts (questions and answers union) joined to user profile info where available. One row per post preserving post id, type and owner for downstream filtering and aggregation. | Use for: analysis of posts enriched with user demographics or reputation; filter posts by owner reputation or location; compute per-user post aggregates from this denormalized table
